comments.note: Fix-Forward applied: removed stale '(tag detection is stubbed until M7)' phrase from INameParser.Parse XML summary. Tag detection is now live. Build verified 0 errors, 0 warnings.

NameParser.DetectTags private method is structurally identical to DetectStudios (longest-match case-insensitive Regex loop). The duplication is intentional — tag detection may add word-boundary guards in the future that would diverge from studio matching. No action needed now, but future maintainers should know this is a deliberate copy-not-abstract decision.

DetectTags and DetectStudios each construct new Regex objects per name per Parse call. For large tag vocabularies this is O(n) Regex allocations. Since NameParser is registered as a singleton and knownTagNames is passed per-call, a static ConcurrentDictionary<string, Regex> cache keyed by tag name would eliminate repeated compilations without changing the stateless contract. Low priority until tag vocabulary grows large.
